quote: Before heading to the show, I was able to find a place to grab dinner … within walking distance of the venue. We even used the app’s bag check feature to make sure all my belongings in my purse, and the size of my purse would fit the venue’s standards. While watching Charli XCX perform, we found her set list in the app and followed along easily.
name: Cassidy
context: App Store review · Charli XCX in Toronto
